sector_window_measurements.endpoint_definition: Endpoint return: P(T)/P(S_N) - 1, where T is the explicit end session and S_N is the canonical US session exactly N positions before T, so a 5-session return spans 6 session endpoints. Relative wealth is (1+R_group)/(1+R_benchmark) - 1 -- a wealth ratio, never a return difference. Interior gaps never move an endpoint; they are disclosed as observed coverage. Prices are strictly positive, finite, total-return adjusted closes read at the two endpoints only.

diagnostics.coverage_note: observed_n counts usable observations inside the window; an interior gap never moves an endpoint

units.breadth_accel: theme breadth now - breadth ~prior_snapshot ago (PIT, the broadening gauge)
units.breadth_cov: W2a coverage-normalised breadth: mean of (up-dn)/n_covering over members with n_covering>=MIN_COVERING; None when fewer than MIN_MEMBERS_COV members have coverage data
units.breadth_accel_basis_days: days to the declared prior snapshot basis

entries.statement: Positive revision breadth in the supplied snapshot is consistent with improving covered-member expectations; price cause is not established.

falsifier.check: A later qualified same-cohort snapshot that loses positive revision breadth would challenge this reading; check revision dates, coverage and revision counts.

entries.statement: Coverage of 3 of 5 configured members with source-native broadening state ROLLING warrants caution on breadth and momentum despite a POSITIVE level state.

falsifier.check: Later qualified broadening evidence with wider coverage would challenge this caution; no coverage threshold is asserted here.

entries.statement: The separately dated bottleneck snapshot (band NEUTRAL, as of 2026-09-01) does not confirm contemporaneous physical tightness in the revision snapshot dated 2026-11-03. Its language leg and member fingerprint are provisional.

falsifier.check: Qualified contemporaneous physical-supply owner evidence could change this assessment; provisional language-leg and fingerprint signals are insufficient alone.

entries.statement: Market-global risk is descriptive context, not a causal explanation of the theme revision state; resolving this alternative needs owner evidence that establishes or contradicts a specified mechanism.

falsifier.check: Owner evidence that establishes or contradicts a specified non-theme mechanism would be required to resolve this alternative.
